#!/usr/bin/env python3
import sys
import subprocess
import json

def print_header(title):
    print("=" * 20 + f" {title} " + "=" * 20)

def check_python():
    print_header("Python Version")
    version = sys.version.splitlines()[0]
    print(f"Version: {version}")
    # Require at least Python 3.8
    major, minor = sys.version_info.major, sys.version_info.minor
    if major > 3 or (major == 3 and minor >= 8):
        print("Requirement: ✅ Python >= 3.8")
    else:
        print("Requirement: ❌ Python >= 3.8 (failed)")

def check_pip():
    print_header("Installed Packages (pip freeze)")
    try:
        result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-m", "pip", "freeze"], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True)
        print(result.stdout.strip())
        print("Requirement: ✅ pip available")
    except subprocess.CalledProcessError as e:
        print("Requirement: ❌ pip not available")
        print(e)

def main():
    print_header("Environment Check Report")
    check_python()
    check_pip()
    print("\nENV_CHECK_SUCCESS")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
